summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and developments in the retail sector, particularly regarding inflation and funding activities.

bullets.text: Supreme Court orders a committee to investigate pharma companies giving freebies to doctors for drug prescriptions.
India's retail inflation is projected to rise to 5.47% in September from 4.82% in August, driven by food price increases.
Nat Habit raises Rs 142 crore in Series C funding to expand its manufacturing capacity and distribution network.
Reliance Consumer leads investment activity this week, focusing on manufacturing capacity and business expansion.
Three Indian states have released over 100 people detained during CJP protests, including Abhijeet Dipke and Saurav Das.
